name: What is the typical timeline for a ground-up residential construction project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a ground-up residential construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a ground-up residential construction project can vary significantly based on the home's size, complexity, site conditions, and material selections. While smaller, simpler homes might be completed in 8-12 months, larger, custom luxury residences can take 12-24 months or more. This duration includes design, permitting, construction, and final inspections. AKN Design Group focuses on clear communication and scheduling transparency throughout the process, providing upfront estimates and managing expectations from concept to completion to ensure a well-coordinated progression.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ground-up construction timelines vary from 8-12 months for simpler homes to 12-24+ months for complex custom residences. AKN Design Group prioritizes clear communication and scheduling transparency.
